'''2007 Ohio State Championship Matt Sherrington DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matt Sherrington]] at [[2007 Ohio State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|SE-D-carbonchambertesting.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' OTA STARTER
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
